title: AI generates property images for design discussions
summary: EDIT by DIY Render, from 3D Architectural Solutions, generates and revises property images for design discussions; no source measures time saved or faster sales.
source_collection: University of Texas AI Opportunity Inventory
account: 3D Architectural Solutions first offered its image tool under the name VIBE as a free alpha test, on a page dated 9 August 2024. The company now offers EDIT by DIY Render to generate and revise images of interiors, exteriors and design plans. The EDIT page dates from 20 September 2025 and sells images at $0.50 per generation. The product page shows examples and describes uses in renovation discussions and property visualization. The company’s terms, updated on 23 May 2026, identify Google Gemini and Replicate services and warn that outputs can be inaccurate. The company states that some edits will not work and that precise refinements with vague direction are the most difficult. The company's material describes the capability on offer. It contains no product-specific evaluation of time savings, sales conversion or sale prices.
purpose: The product is intended to help users create and revise conceptual property images for planning and communication.
